name: Fuyuura Megumi
source:
She works as the proprietress of Tsuki no Hotori (Beside the Moon), a small restaurant in the corner of Koukashi. She is currently living with an older brother with whom she has no blood relationship.

[From [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/04/17/getsuei-no-kusari/] Otome Jikan[/url]]
